notes:
Summary: Emberfall (mid-market trading platform) is negotiating an enterprise Dedicated contract for deterministic inference for trader-facing assistants and signal reranking. They require strict uptime, defined credits, scheduled maintenance windows, and explicit support SLAs.

Business needs / drivers:
- Deterministic latency for trader UI: p50 target <40ms, p95 <120ms for 4k token context for model-inference endpoints.
- Throughput: baseline 80k tokens/min sustained during US market hours, with burst to 200k tokens/min during open/close spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit to reserved capacity if latency/throughput guarantees are contractually enforced.

SLA asks discussed (customer draft):
- Uptime target: 99.99% monthly for dedicated pool (acceptable: minimum 99.95% with escalations).
- Credit schedule requested by Legal: 0.5% credit for 99.95-99.99%, 3% credit for 99.9-99.95%, 10% credit for 99.0-99.9%, termination right if <98% for two consecutive months.
- Maintenance windows: primary acceptable window 02:00-04:00 ET monthly; maintenance must be scheduled with 21 days notice and cannot overlap critical earnings windows (calendar to be provided).
- Support response/engagement: P1 (severity: production outage affecting trader workflows) — initial response 15 minutes, on-call engineer engaged within 1 hour, 24/7 escalation path; P2 — initial response 1 hour, next-business-hour fix estimate; P3 — response within 8 business hours.
- Performance credits tied to objective latency SLOs (p95 latency credit if p95 degrades >25% vs baseline for >30 minutes). Customer insists on measurable, token-level telemetry shipped into their console or shared dashboard for audit.

Reserved GPU planning (what we discussed):
- Proposed reserved footprint: 12x H100-80GB equivalents (sustained pool) with contractual burst pool of +4 GPUs for market spikes; autoscale policies to be predefined with cold-start limits.
- Model profile: Llama-3-70B or Redwood-verified equivalent, 8-bit quantized runtime, KV caching for repeated sessions. Expect average per-token cost targets to meet their internal budget.
- Throughput guarantee mapping: 12x H100 -> baseline 80k tokens/min at target latency; we will validate during POC and adjust commit size if p95 exceeds targets.

POC and validation plan agreed:
- 2-week production-like POC: realistic traffic replay from Emberfall (sanitized) to validate p50/p95 throughput and cost; run in dedicated test pool.
- Deliverables: latency/throughput report, token-level cost breakdown, kernel-selection profile and recommended batch settings.
- Acceptance criteria: p50/p95 within 15% of target and no data residency/security issues unresolved.

Open legal/ops items (blockers):
- Finalize credit schedule language (legal wants explicit numeric caps and maximum aggregate credits per quarter).
- SOC2 Type II evidence + penetration test attestation must be attached to SOW.
- Network peering & IP allowlisting: Emberfall requires fixed egress IPs and a 2-week lead time for Direct Connect setup.

Quotes / direct customer comments:
- CTO (J. Ramirez): "We can pay for determinism, but we need the contract to reflect real penalties when latency and uptime affect traders."
- Head of infra: "We need token-level telemetry exported to our Splunk instance; anything opaque won't pass audit."

Immediate next actions (short bullets):
- Draft updated SLA with proposed credit bands and latency-SLO tied credit triggers (owner: Legal + Claire) — target 2026-03-17.
- Confirm capacity sizing after POC baseline run (owner: Arjun) — schedule POC start 2026-03-22.
- Security deliverables: attach SOC2 docs and run on-prem network checklist with Emberfall security (Nina to coordinate).

Sales notes (tone/CRM snippets):
- High propensity to sign if Dedicated pool meets latency SLOs and legal sign-off on credits is acceptable.
- Primary objection is compensation model for outages vs. business impact — propose capped credits + engineering SLA to provide faster time-to-resolution.
- Recommend escalation to Revenue Operations for custom billing cadence once ARR band finalized.
